europe_now.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
europe_now.summary: A strike on a weapons depot in Kyiv killed at least 37 people and forced the evacuation of hundreds of residents. The attack caused significant casualties and disrupted normal activity in the capital.

sources.headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot

europe_now.title: Icelanders say no to restarting talks to join the EU
europe_now.summary: Voters in Iceland rejected a proposal to restart European Union accession talks in a national referendum. The result indicates a preference to maintain the country's current status outside the EU.

sources.headline: Icelanders say no to restarting talks to join the EU

top_stories.title: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
top_stories.summary: Norway's newly crowned king delivered his first national address, paying tribute to his late father. The speech marked the beginning of his reign following the recent succession.

sources.headline: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech

top_stories.title: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas
top_stories.summary: Greek and Turkish authorities confronted each other over competing claims to protected marine zones in the Aegean Sea. The dispute underscores ongoing tensions between the two NATO allies over maritime boundaries.

sources.headline: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas

top_stories.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
top_stories.summary: A shooting at a Swiss rave party resulted in the death of a 22‑year‑old woman and left five others injured. Police launched a manhunt to apprehend the perpetrator.

sources.headline: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
